Paragraph: Summary of Passage: The physical senses are higher than dull matter; the mind is higher than the senses; the intellect is higher than the mind; and the spiritual soul is higher than the intellect.
Situation/Problem_Faced: Understanding the internal hierarchy of human consciousness to regain control over turbulent impulses.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Krishna maps the psychological and spiritual hierarchy: Matter < Senses < Mind < Intellect < Soul. Knowing that the self is higher than intellect gives the individual ultimate leverage.
Outcome/Resolution: Arjuna gains structural clarity on how higher faculties can govern lower impulses.

Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Psychological Hierarchy: Understanding the structural levels of bodily, emotional, and cognitive functions
Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Top-Down Self-Regulation: Using higher intellect and awareness to govern lower sensory urges
Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Reclaiming Core Identity: Anchoring identity in spiritual awareness rather than shifting mental states

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Indriyani parany ahur indriyebhyah param manah (Senses are superior to matter, mind is superior to senses)
Manasas tu para buddhir yo buddheh paratas tu sah (Intellect is superior to mind, and the soul is superior to intellect)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Krishna presents the internal hierarchy of existence: senses are above physical matter, the mind is above the senses, the intellect is above the mind, and the soul (atma) transcends the intellect.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Self-mastery relies on top-down regulation. When you recognize that your core awareness is higher than your thoughts, emotions, and sensory urges, you gain the power to observe and direct them intentionally.
